id: P3 eyes-open/closed result carries its between-recording qualification
claim: remaining real-data effect was that eyes-open and eyes-closed recordings differed
why: between_recording_control: the ratio compares two separate recordings against within-recording drift; it must not be quoted without that. In the 2026-09-27 text the 1.3 ratio is first given in §3.2 (dependence) and restated at the head of §3.5, whose paragraph carries the separate-runs qualification; the rule guards the §3.5 statement.

id: P3 localization 10/15 is not sold as an advantage
why: a two-recording margin on fifteen is inside binomial noise; stating the win without that reads as a demonstrated performance advantage the benchmark does not support.

id: P3 structural-scenario win carries the pre-registered shortfall
requires: falls short of the 0\.30|not established at the pre-registered level
why: the +0.25 margin falls short of the +0.30 threshold fixed in advance, so the advantage is real but not established at the pre-registered level.

id: P3 bundle apparatus carries its ablation result
requires: net negative|never shown to work|not tested here|lowered discrimination
why: fibre_ablation found the bundle net negative; it must not be presented as working.

id: P3 localization counts carry the centring caveat
why: every within-trajectory localization window is symmetric about the true transition, so a centre-prior detector scores 22/22 there and 0/22 off-centre (localization_centerbias_control); any 10/15 localization figure quoted without that caveat reads as evidence the method localizes. The caveat must sit within 400 characters of each count (a caveat elsewhere in a long paragraph about a different number does not cover it).

id: P3 sleep discrimination carries the EOG attribution
why: the sleep covariance includes horizontal EOG, and with it removed the discrimination holds in only 2 of 4 subjects (discrimination_eog_ablation)

id: P3 MDM framing carries the design asymmetry
claim: these are traps of this method
why: mdm_trap_control keeps absolute power and uses non-overlapping epochs; it separates this design from the standard one, not this classifier from another

id: P3 MDM 'none applied' carries the above-chance same-state result
claim: None of the four|any of the four that apply
why: mdm_trap_control T2: two same-state recordings classified at 0.65 (bar 0.70, chance 0.50)

id: P3 survey counts carry their Unclear range
